purpose: Extraire des documents WebApp fournis les bonnes pratiques génériques, en excluant métier, branding et couplages spécifiques.
implemented_bricks: resource registry with stable logical IDs
facet filter engine with OR inside groups and AND between groups
explicitly_not_copied: HTML embedded in Bash as framework architecture
design_rules: configuration and data replace hard-coded project constants
templates replace generated HTML embedded inside shell scripts
stable IDs replace direct cross-page filesystem coupling
destructive generators expose preview/confirmation policy and produce receipts
